patterns_extracted.description: When Manus changes a weight in a weighted-sum scoring system, always verify the total sums to exactly 1.00
When Manus adds new discovery sources in gem_scanner, check if the same source already exists earlier in the scan loop
Manus frequently uses bare variable names instead of quoted string keys in dict.get() calls inside f-strings. Always grep for pos.get(word) without quotes after Manus edits.
Manus occasionally introduces indentation errors in deeply nested try/except blocks. Always run AST parse check on all modified files.
Docker Compose service name is 'bot', not 'shamrock-bot'. The container_name is 'shamrock-bot' but docker compose commands use the service name.
When git push/commit hangs with no output, the PAT embedded in the remote URL is likely expired. The osxkeychain credential helper may pop a hidden prompt. Fix: get new PAT and update remote URL.
